limitations: Released records are broadly two-photon preselected, not full raw timetag acquisition; no excluded-attempt or first-photon reconstruction.
No-click readouts are retained with sign -1, never discarded.
Timestamp is naive calendar time, not certified UTC.
Counts in this registry are reviewed derived records, not raw reexecution.
Conditional exclusion targets local-response realization plus settings, herald/readout, calibration and fixed-N assumptions; no IDT/QM acceptance or unconditional primitive rejection.
Retrospective dataset/policy selection and unverified calibration/stopping provenance are outside the per-run conditional risk guarantee.
